description: This file defines the SocketConnectionFactory class responsible for creating and managing socket connections within the Orleans networking framework. It includes methods for establishing TCP connections asynchronously, handling socket options, and managing connection lifecycle. It also defines a custom exception class for socket connection errors.

classes.name: SocketConnectionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing socket connections asynchronously, with support for socket options and error handling.

classes.name: SingleUseSocketAsyncEventArgs
classes.description: A sealed subclass of SocketAsyncEventArgs that encapsulates a TaskCompletionSource to signal completion of socket async operations.

classes.name: SocketConnectionException
classes.description: Custom exception class for socket connection errors, serializable and derived from OrleansException.

methods.name: SocketConnectionFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with logger, schedulers, memory pool, and options.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously establishes a TCP socket connection to the specified endpoint, applying socket options and handling connection errors.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Overrides the method to signal completion of socket async operations.

methods.name: SocketConnectionException
methods.description: Constructors for creating socket connection exception instances with message and inner exception.
